items.title: What Does Boeing (BA) Winning A 150 Jet Order Mean Now?
items.summary: Boeing (NYSE:BA) and Turkish Airlines have finalized an agreement for up to 150 737 MAX jets, the carrier's largest single aisle order with Boeing. The deal covers firm orders and options across the 737 MAX family, aligning with Turkish Airlines' expanding narrow body fleet plans. Boeing highlights the agreement as part of broader airline efforts to renew fleets and support lower emissions on short and medium haul routes.
